newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks seen down on profit taking, peso off.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks seen down on profit taking, peso off.

text.p: Traders saw Mexican stocks opening with light downside potential on Monday as the market consolidates last week's record-breaking rally.
"The bourse still has much underlying strength, but a (downward) adjustment at this stage is to be expected," one desk trader said.
Technical analysts placed support for the IPC index at 4,135 points, compared to Friday's close of 4,160.85.
